renewal_terms: Initial term of 10 years, renewable annually for up to another 10 years on the same terms and conditions
key_obligations: Send renewal or non-renewal notice to LIMEENERGYCO before the term end

risk_flags.issue: Agreement allows automatic annual renewals for up to ten additional years without explicit customer consent or right to terminate early, creating a long-term commitment with no clear exit strategy.
risk_flags.suggested_redline: Add a clause allowing the Distributor to terminate the Agreement upon 90 days' written notice at any time during the Term.

recommendation: Do not execute in current form due to high risk from automatic renewals for up to ten additional years without a clear exit strategy. Add a termination clause allowing the Distributor to terminate with 90 days' written notice at any time during the Term.
